integrity: All computation described was run from included standalone scripts and is corroborative; the infinite result relies on a cyclic-gap proof. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers maximum independent sets only and at most two extra cyclic positions; it does not determine four-regular diameters or treat arbitrary slack. Equivalent prior coverage in unindexed publications remains possible.
title: A two-slack reconfiguration transition in powers of cycles
